patch.value: GH-831: actionable unknown-author health evidence is truncated without a complete disposition selector
Track the GitHub report that health exposes only 20 actionable unknown-author event coordinates while the acknowledgement command requires the complete item-id:line set.

Health declares actionable-event truncation and a continuation or complete projection; acknowledgement supports an evidence-backed bulk selector without weakening reviewer, reason, or append-only audit requirements; SDK, CLI, MCP, docs, and large-workspace tests share one contract
Agents can retrieve and disposition the complete actionable event set in one bounded, evidence-backed workflow with explicit truncation metadata.
Health reports the full actionable count but exposes only 20 coordinates, and the acknowledgement command accepts only individually enumerated events.
